messages:
anya: Quick rehearsal checklist for Thu's announce — need final prod changelog anchor, CDN cache purge for hero images, canary rollout percentages, and sales webhook routing confirmed. Who's got which item?

sophie: I'll own the changelog. PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/451. Plan to flip staging->prod at T-90m. Anchor will be /release/2026-03-26#technical-notes.

eli: Webinar rehearsal at 09:15 PT — 15m run-through. We want the announce ~5m before the email drop. Suggest announce at 09:35 PT, email at 09:40 PT so people have time to click register. Thoughts?

marco: Ops asks: canary plan is 5% at T0 for 10m, then 25% for 10m, then 100%. If marketing wants the post when canary is at 25% that's safer. If you still want earlier, we can do 09:35 announce with canary start at 09:30.

anya: Let's aim for announce 09:40 PT, email 09:45 PT, so canary has 10m headroom. Sophie, can you get the docs anchor live by T-60m?

sophie: Yep. I'll merge at T-90m so docs build and anchor is stable by T-60m.

lina: Sales lead routing: webhook https://hooks.sales.redwood.ai/announce now expects X-Sales-Signature HMAC and returns route in header X-Route-Group. Sales-bot will validate. Also want utm_term=announce_newsletter for newsletter segment.

sales-bot: Test POST (T-2h) returned 200 with X-Route-Group: sales-enterprise for sample payload. Auth validated.

marco: CDN cache: I'll purge /assets/launch/* at T-70m. Confirm the hero + compact images are uploaded to prod CDN path. Also enabling stricter cache-control for the hero so social scrapers pick the right image.

anya: Asset links (prod): hero https://cdn.redwood.ai/launch/26mar/hero-wide.png compact https://cdn.redwood.ai/launch/26mar/bench-compact.png (alt text noted in assets). Use hero for posts and compact for tweets.

eli: Social one-liner options for A/B: A) "See how we cut inference cost — new batching & graceful fallbacks. Join the demo." B) "Faster inference, fewer outages — live demo Thurs 9:45 PT." We'll A/B in social and email subject lines.

marco: Healthcheck endpoint /v1/announce/health will be polled at T-2m and T+1m. Rollback criteria: revert canary if 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 3m OR error budget burn > 15% in 5m. Ops alerting on.

anya: Small ask: can engineering expose a lightweight endpoint that returns docs_anchor and asset_manifest so marketing can programmatically verify links before publish? Not required but helpful.

marco: Sure — will add /internal/announce/verify returning simple text lines with anchors. Hoping to have it live by T-3h.

sophie: Also adding a short changelog excerpt for social: "Adaptive batching tuned for short contexts; safe fallback to quantized-v2 under memory pressure; streaming stability fixes." Keep it under 140 chars for tweets.

eli: Email variants: subject A uses cost angle, B uses reliability angle. Schedule send groups: newsletter to segmented list at 09:45 PT, webinar open registration rolling to social CTR.

lina: Lead routing rules posted to sales Confluence. Reminder: enterprise routing when company_size>=500; otherwise route to nurture. SLA: Sales to triage enterprise within 1 hour, nurture flows start immediately.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled by marco: canary 7123450800, ramp 7123451400. Healthcheck snapshot at T-30m: 200 OK, p95 36ms.

anya: Everything sounds green. Final lock: announce 09:40 PT? or 09:45 PT? Marco, recommend 09:45 PT to match email at 09:50 PT?

marco: Recommend 09:45 PT announce (canary warmed), email 09:50 PT. I'll post healthcheck at T-2m and purge CDN at T-70m.

anya: OK locked: announce 09:45 PT, email 09:50 PT. Sophie will paste final prod changelog anchor here once live. Everyone drop :thumbsup: when done.

sophie: :thumbsup: changelog merged and anchor live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-26#technical-notes

eli: :thumbsup: rehearsal set for 09:15 PT.

lina: :thumbsup: sales webhook validated.

marco: :thumbsup: ops monitoring configured, CDN purge scheduled.

anya: Perfect. I'll assemble the publish bundle and post in #marketing-announce at T-10m with final copy, links, and UTM parameters. Closing loop.
